run_bbox_mode: run the single camera human bounding box detection pipeline using hydra config
run_pose2d_mode: run the single camera 2D human pose estimation pipeline using hydra config
get_context: build a Context dataclass from a Config object with cache dirs and model paths
mode_bbox: detect human bounding boxes across video frames using a detector model and region proposals
mode_pose2d: estimate 2D human keypoints from saved bounding boxes using a pose estimation model
